About

The Cho Gar Wing Chun Story

A rare branch of Wing Chun, preserved within the Cho family for generations — now taught for the first time in Germany.

Our Story

A Family Tradition, Now Open to Germany

Cho Gar Wing Chun is a distinct and rarely-taught branch of Wing Chun Kung Fu, preserved within the Cho family across generations in China. Unlike more widely commercialized Wing Chun lineages, Cho Gar has remained a close, family-guarded tradition — passed from teacher to student with great care.

Nils Ring, a member of the Cho family, has brought this system to Germany for the first time, founding Cho Gar Wing Chun to responsibly share this authentic art with students who value tradition, precision and genuine skill over shortcuts.

Our goal is simple: to introduce Cho Gar Wing Chun to a wider European audience, while staying true to the principles, forms and philosophy exactly as they were transmitted within the family.

What We Stand For

  • Respect for the lineage and its history
  • Discipline in training and everyday life
  • Patience on the path toward mastery
  • Preserving authenticity over shortcuts
Your Instructor

The Person Behind Cho Gar Wing Chun in Germany

Trained directly within the Cho family lineage — the only certified representative of this system in Germany.

曹

Sifu Nils Ring

Official Representative of Cho Gar Wing Chun in Germany · Member of the Cho Family

Trained directly within the Cho family lineage, Sifu Nils Ring is dedicated to preserving and sharing this authentic art with the next generation of students — teaching Cho Gar Wing Chun exactly as it was passed down, without shortcuts or modifications.

Every class is personally taught, so students learn directly from an authentic source rather than through layers of instructors removed from the original lineage. Sifu Nils Ring also travels for seminars across Germany and leads the Cho Gar Wing Chun Instructor Programme — learn more here.
